Author: Luci
Name: Advanced Penumbra Item Converter
Description: Convert gear, facewear, hair, face, tail and Viera-ear assets in Penumbra mods to other items, slots and races. Supports the Penumbra 1.7+ mod format, retargets game paths, model/material references and metadata, and verifies the result.
Punchline: Retarget Penumbra mods to a different item ID in-game.
